newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco says receives offers for $500 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Codelco says receives offers for $500 mln loan.

text.p: Chile's state copper company Codelco said it has received 11 offers from banks to lead a $500 million syndicated loan the corporation is seeking to restructure its short and long term debts.
Codelco gave no details of the offers for the loan, which will be for a period of between five and seven years, but said the terms were favorable.
"A preliminary analysis of the offers, indicates that the conditions will probabaly set a new point of reference for the country and Latin America," said the statement.
The corporation, the world's largest copper producer, said it would select the winning bid in the near future.
